caption:
Most service businesses lose leads before they even know it.

The Lead Response Audit shows you exactly where you stand, and what the gap is costing you.

Enter your monthly leads, average job value, and how fast you respond. It hands back three things:

- Your response score, graded against speed-to-lead benchmarks
- Leads you're losing every month at your current speed
- Revenue at risk from slow follow-up

Four inputs. Two minutes. No cost, no signup.
